a.text: Normally, we don't get closure right when something happens.
Just like when Mum and Aunt Jemma had that argument in the middle of the night. Such a noisy one it woke the neighbors––
They were arguing about the same old: 'How should the factory go about starting up the wheat grinder and the rice miller without disturbing the workers' rest.'
Just like those young Billy businessmen who helped the farmers and factory workers build a coalition during the 'Cage Incident'––

Even though they made an effort to break free of the grasp of the counts and the Victorian Chamber of Commerce, how many of them were just in it for the business? How many of them actually cared about the future of the Rim Billitonians?
Also, just like that one trip, with the Doctor and Amiya...
Maybe some questions will always have some sort of closure.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Eh? Dunno where you're gonna go yet?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Wasn't heading back to the nomadic platform to search for traces of your childhood just the first stop along the journey? Like, what happened to the second stop, and third stop, and so on...?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: I filled a tank of gas and even prepped a portable stove and a tent...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Besides, the Rim Billiton Miners' Cup is in the group stage right now... If we head straight south, we might make it in time for the cross-country burdenbeast race across Big Hammer Mine...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Or maybe we could go for some of Rim Billiton's local specialties? I've committed a lotta fantastic eateries to memory over the last few years, especially the ones that've opened up inside hollowed-out mining tunnels.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: In any case, Kal'tsit said that you guys don't have any work coming up for the next little while. So, why not put that whole Victoria thing on the backburner for now?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Th-There's no need to be pushy, Savage... It's not that I'm too worried about what's over the horizon to enjoy the trip or anything!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What I mean is, I think I might prefer how we used to do things before, like just wandering around without any particular goal in mind.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Well, umm, that might not be entirely accurate either. I'm sure the Doctor had some idea of where we were going.

options: ...I did?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Because as far as I can remember, it seems like new things are happening every day, and there are always different sights to see.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If we were here to casually tour through Rim Billiton's barrenlands, we'd probably just be seeing a whole lot of sand, mines, and Originium clusters.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Well, about that... I think that's moreso you're having a streak of bad luck, and getting yourselves into trouble the whole way here...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: At least Amiya's more than capable of holding her own now, and I'm not the same empty-headed, hot-blooded newbie I was before. Even if we run into a scrap, I'm sure we can resolve it without too much hassle...

options: Ouch!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: S-Sorry about that, Doctor!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor! Are you alright? Did you bump your head?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: What was that sound just now?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor... If you've hurt your head, please speak up...

options: It's fine... My head's still intact.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Savage... What happened? Why'd you suddenly slam on the brakes?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Take a look over there––

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: See that transport vehicle over there coughin' up smoke?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Jacker, go get some bottletree water. The more the better!

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Bring a tarp over and help me hold her up.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Then, grab some tape and tie her to the condensate pipe, then dip her feet in cold water and give her a good soak.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Okay. But, why?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Call it a trade secret. Doesn't matter if it's a fever or a burn, this is the fastest way to cool down!

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Medicine's fine and all, but you sometimes need to tackle the external problem head on, and this is the way you do it!

steps.name: Potlid
steps.text: Lanns...

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Don't worry. There's nothing to be scared of. I've got meds. I figured something like this would happen sooner or later... Hurry up and drink, Warmy.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: She's burning up.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: She has the strength to swallow the meds, so it's not as bad as it could be. The fever should be going down soon.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Yeah. I know it can't be that serious. Trust me.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Alright, I believe you.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: But, I don't think what she has is a fever.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: ...I know.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: It's her Arts. She used them to fiddle with the temperature of the power plant again. Without my permission.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Shoulda dawned on me a lot earlier when I realized how smooth the ride was and how much power we had driving on these roads.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: I don't know how many times I've told her not to go around casting with her bare hands, but she just can't get it drilled into her head. She's always eager to prove her own worth.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Silly girl. What a darned fool. I knew from the moment she got in the truck that she was dumb and stubborn...

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: ...Damned dipstick.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: We can always find a doctor. We're not that far from a platform.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: You're not getting anything from those docs that I can't already do.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Trust me, we'll be fine. I'll get us through this.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: If you say so...

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Alanna, the power cabin's getting hotter and hotter.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Yeah? Can't tell, since my back's still dripping cold sweat...

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Agh. She's burning up. How.. is she this hot?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: I've got another folk remedy. Can you go catch some Originium slugs...?

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Alanna, there's the bell. Someone wants to board.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Gah. Go chase them off, jacker.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: No, you should go.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: It'll be bad if her Arts go out of control. She'll hurt herself, and others too.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: What are you trying to say––

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: No way. No way it would come to that. Not a chance. She's my own adopted daughter.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: You just wait, Ray. I'll take care of this whole mess.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: I'll be right back.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: If an Infected gets sick, or if their Arts start going out of control, it should be another Infected to deal with it.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: That way, even if they disintegrate, it at least won't create new victims.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: That's standard protocol on the job.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Get out.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Wait a sec! I'm the driver for that vehicle over there. I've got tools. Do you need any help?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Help? Hah. With what? I'm doing just fine over here.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: We're just taking a little break over here. So, if you wanna help, buggering off would do us just fine.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Huh? But your ute over there is giving off white smoke. Doesn't look to be in great shape...

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: That's just how it is. I'm the one driving it. Think you know her better than me?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Sorry. I'd still like to get in and have a look around.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: I don't have time to give you a ride.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Last warning. Go away, or I'll make you go away.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: ...You're shaking.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Who, me? Don't kid yourself.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Though, that gear you're wearing...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: ––You're a troublemaker who's done something bad, aren't you?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: ––And you're a merc out on the hunt for Infected people, yeah?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: An explosion–– from inside the bus?!

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Strewth, I told you to bugger off! I don't have time for you!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Hey, wait!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: What's going on with that truck? Its body is damaged in several areas, and the front's rather deformed...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: The smoke should be coming from the condensate pipe not properly dispersing the heat...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: And then, there's that driver...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: She seems to be worse for wear than the bus itself...

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Poor gray-ears.
The engine has long since stalled, but the sound of water flowing through the condensate pipe can still be heard from the power cabin.
The temperature inside the cabin is unusually high, but the drenched Potlid continues to shiver.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Alanna said this was supposed to help.

steps.name: Potlid
steps.text: Just... a bit longer... then...
As her words trail off, Potlid's lips quiver slightly, as if sleep-talking.
Ray thinks for a moment, then holds the girl's scorching-hot hand. Though the hand subconsciously tries to shrink away, it has no strength to do so.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: ...Burning hot.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: It's alright. Now, I'll be able to see how badly your Arts are going out of control.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: This isn't any miraculous technique or anything, but I can at least reduce the danger a bit.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Some people are fine sticking their head in the sand, some coop themselves up in abandoned mine shafts and wait for the whole thing to get blown up and sealed off, and others try to run far, far away into the barrens.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Sure. People get sick, just like old parts get rusty. Bound to happen.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: As long as you handle it properly, it won't affect anyone else, and it won't turn into a big deal.

steps.name: Potlid
steps.text: I don't want this...

steps.name: Potlid
steps.text: ...Ray!

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Easy there, gray-ears. Your body temperature's still high.

steps.name: Potlid
steps.text: A long time ago, everyone in my family, the whole family, they were all Infected.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Potlid
steps.text: All of them... knew how to put their noses to the grindstone. They built their own homes... and lived simple but fulfilling lives.

steps.name: Potlid
steps.text: I was happy too. I could... make a big pot of soup and share it with everyone...

steps.name: Potlid
steps.text: They'd eat yummy food... and then they'd get better. After they got better, they wouldn't need to come back anymore...

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Easy now, gray-ears. If your temperature gets any higher...
A few sparks crackle through the air.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: I can't hold you anymore.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: I know what I'm doing, gray-ears. Some people don't know how to control their own strength, and end up hurting people or even killing them by accident. But, that's not me. I'm going to knock you out... You'll just be sore for a few days.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: I'm letting go now.

steps.name: Potlid
steps.text: If I... eat more... and grow up more... and my sickness gets better... Dad, will also come back...

steps.name: Potlid
steps.text: Why... were those people on the road looking for Infected? Why do I have to hurt Lanns, just because I'm an Infected?
The rawness of the blisters on her hand force Ray to pause.

steps.name: Potlid
steps.text: Ray....

steps.name: Potlid
steps.text: Is it bad... to be an Infected?

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Well...

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Gray-ears... You must be hurting.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: I can feel it.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: There are times when the Oripathy flares up and I can't sleep, I know.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: But when I remember that ray of light shining through... I can relax, and finally close my eyes in peace.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: 'Feranmut'...

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: ...Calm, gray-ears. Calm down. I WILL find it.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: ––Potlid! Potlid!

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: How's she doing?!

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: You... This blood...

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Alanna, I...

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: ...Gray-ears is fine, but stay back. Her heat's gone down a little.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: She's already caused a small explosion. Alanna, these damaged internal components and broken pipes, are they a big deal?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: The pipe is whatever, but...

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: The medicine... doesn't seem to be working.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: See, I said you needed help...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: ...Huh? The saw, wrenches, duct tape... And, this girl... I've seen her before...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Why'd you tie this little girl up? What are you doing to her?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: What am I doing?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: What... am I even capable of doing?

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Alanna...

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: I'm not an idiot. You think I don't know these tricks don't work? You think I haven't seen an old friend getting heatstroke in the workshop, then being tortured with these crude methods to the point that he never came to work again?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: 'Rusty Wrench' managed to survive. Couldn't talk anymore, but he could still work; Old Bobby said it saved his life... But, you think I don't know they're the exception that proves the rule?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: You really think... I don't know Oripathy is an intractable disease?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: But, this dumb kid doesn't know that. She thinks she can be cured. What else can I do but play along?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: I believe in the little medicine I can get my hands on, and whatever folk remedies reach my ears.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: I can't just... watch another one die in front of me while I watch helplessly.

options: Greetings, ma'am.
Mind if we take a look at the girl?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Sleep peacefully now. You don't have to burn yourself anymore

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm sorry for using my Arts on you...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: May you be free from the pain and suffering of Oripathy in your dreams.

options: Her subconscious casting has already stopped.
Good work, Amiya.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I could feel it. She is a deeply wounded girl.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Is there anything else I can help with, Doctor?

options: We're good for now.
A simple injection should take care of things.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm done with my Arts too... Go ahead and let the others in.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Is she really going to be okay?!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mhm. Her subconscious casting has stopped, and the activation process of the Originium crystals inside her body has also been halted. But the fever symptoms haven't been completely relieved yet, and we'll have to continue monitoring her for a while.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: I've been driving this truck around for who-knows-how-long. Never thought I'd run into a doctor in a place like this...

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: ...All I can say is, thank you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You're welcome. Treating the Infected has always been Rhodes Island's duty.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That said, I'm not a doctor, and the Doctor is, well, not that kind of doctor. Just to be sure, we should get to the Rhodes Island branch office ASAP, where we'd have real diagnostic and treatment equipment to properly examine the patient.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: ...Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: That reminds me. The girl gave me a card, saying that some lady told her... to give it to her family.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Oh, I'm the lady.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: The girly was clearly infected, I figured her family ought to understand...

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Hah, found it. This is the one. The symbol of the excavator drill pointed straight at the sky.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...the what?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Ain't easy doing business around Rim Billiton these days. Competition's too fierce, so figured it wouldn't be a bad idea to go tucking instead.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: But your company offers some serious benefits. It's absolutely wild that you'd have such an advanced medical department in a construction firm... If only the Billy companies could learn from you guys!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Um, Alanna, I think there's been a little misunderstanding...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But, I do agree with you. If all of Rim Billiton's companies committed to raising awareness about the Oripathy prevention, our young patient here might not be in such serious condition right now.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And... we should really put what we do at Rhodes Island front-and-center on our business cards. After all, the Infected rarely have proper access to medical services.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: In any case, we'll have a proper medical team dedicated to Warmy's treatment at the branch office. If it's not too much trouble for you, I'd like you to drive for the nearest nomadic city.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Wait, hold on.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: There's a bit of a special situation with the truck. Once we go back, we might not be able to leave again. Plus... I have an agreement with someone else.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Special situation? Oh, that reminds me, you're supposed to be a transport, right?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: But, if you keep going in that direction, the only thing waiting for you is an uninhabited wasteland that's prone to Catastrophes.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Wait, don't tell me... You were planning to go plant bottletrees there?
No... We're... going to search for the 'Feranmut'...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: ...Feranmut?

steps.name: Potlid
steps.text: Please... don't leave Warmy behind...

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Don't worry, nobody's leaving you behind. We're just having a little discussion.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Potlid?!

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: You're awake?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: How's your head? Are you dizzy? Are you still running hot?

steps.name: Potlid
steps.text: Lanns... You look so upset... Did something happen? I think I just had a long and tiring dream...

steps.name: Potlid
steps.text: ...Mm, at the very end of the dream, I think I even saw the Feranmut.

steps.name: Potlid
steps.text: Ray asked me to take a good, long look at the giant shadow. I looked and looked as hard as I could, but I couldn't quite make it out.

steps.name: Potlid
steps.text: Lanns, can I go with you to find the Feranmut?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Here, try this.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: This is all we have now; it hardly enough to express our thanks.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Not only did you save Potlid, but you're even willing to travel with us to make sure she's okay.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No worries, Alanna. We had no particular destination in mind to begin with.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Also, the Doctor's intrigued by the Feranmut you mentioned.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: It's done, Alanna. I've pulled into the transport bay.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: The rest of the journey is up to you.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Hah, no problem there.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: But there is one thing I still don't understand. What exactly is this 'Feranmut' you're searching for?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: It's a type of... Uhh, this massive...

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: All you need to know is, it's some sort of mythical creature! I've heard there are incredible explorers out there planning to turn these legends into documented columns!

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: As for this beast, it flies for months at a time over the windswept dunes of Rim Billiton, flying over the highest peaks to spew flames at the sun. It appears in the mist of nightfall with a luster more brilliant than the moons!

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: We set out this time to look for some more useful clues! Isn't that right? Um... Ray?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: You talking about the lady with the crossbow over there who's hardly said a word this entire time?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Forget it. She can enjoy the cold wind by her lonesome.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: In any case, that's how mighty a Feranmut is.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Eh... That legend sounds all over the place. Don't think I've heard anything of the sort before.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I've heard of it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: A massive fowlbeast devours the clouds in the sky. Before it can finish eating the last cloud, right before the day the sky falls, the people on its back all jump into the boundless sea of stars...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: A long time ago, the Doctor used to tell me bedtime stories like that.

options: I did?
Sorry... Don't remember that.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Well, umm, of course, you put it in different words, but...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I have a vague memory... Your tone at the time, it really made me want to believe the stories were real.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Never would've guessed it, but looks like our friend here has quite a vivid imagination underneath that hood.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: But we're not after fairy stories here! We're looking for the real deal!

steps.name: Potlid
steps.text: Mmmmh~ The freshly stewed, piping-hot sweet potato soup is ready!

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Woo, this is the good stuff! Hurry up and dig in, everyone!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Appreciate it, Warmy!

steps.name: Potlid
steps.text: Don't mention it. There's also veggies cooking in the pot!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Wait a minute... This flavor... Why does it have a hint of Originium slug?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Umm, well, I did add a little bit of slug slime.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: I've tried it before, and the flavor's not too bad. It's soft and chewy, doesn't stick to your teeth, and it shouldn't be poisonous at all.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Wow, I think you're on to something.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: By the way, Alanna, the food you served up before was pretty good. I didn't expect you to be such a cook.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Is it really so surprising? Do I look to you like a woman who doesn't know her way around the kitchen? The factory workers were always tripping over each other to get at my food!

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Though... my real specialties are way more flavorful. Don't care at all for this light, time-consuming stuff.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Everything you ate just now, from the beet soup to the Originium slug slime sweet potato stew, was all prepared by Potlid here. I just served it.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: It's Warmy's work? I know she's getting better and all, but... are you sure it's wise to let her do all that by herself?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Let her rest up, and I'll handle the rest!

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Calm down– Don't go bugging her over it. She can handle it.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: If anything, I think she'd be sad if she felt like there was nothing she could do.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: She's always been like that, wanting to prove that she's all grown up and capable... Which is how she ended up in this condition.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh, right, Alanna...

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Yes?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Has Warmy... been through something?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Even though she's always smiling and full of energy, I feel... a deep sorrow coming from her.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Her inner feelings seem at complete odds with her smile.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: ...Haha.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Kids like to act strong and tough. That's all there is to it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But, normal kids don't cling to it in that way...

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: It's because of what her father said to her before he left home: 'I want you to grow up happily, just as you are now'...

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: The day before he left, it was her birthday. Nasty business, right? Children tend to take things like birthdays and birthday wishes awfully seriously.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Then, where is her dad now...?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Who knows? All I know is, the girl relies on me, because every time her father left home for work, it was in this vehicle.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Miners are the most common types you'll see aboard, with Cautuses a close second. And her father happened to be both. Like hell I'd be able to pick him out of a crowd.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Though, did I ever mention to you that this ol' girl's about to go out of commission?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Because several of the mines I used to stop at got shut down. The last one was due to deep depletion, all the rocks that got dug up were totally worthless. And then two years ago... a mining accident claimed another.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: And so it was over the last two years, when this kid hopped onboard, saying that if she didn't keep the brightest smile on her face, her father wouldn't recognize her.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Alright, I'm gonna go give her some motivation, and a helping hand. She's probably a bit too fired up right now and wants to make a miners' family dinner on that little Originium stove you guys brought over.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: You're pretty nice people too. It's been a long time since she's cooked for anyone else.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Though, I hope what you said when you sat down at this table is true: that you won't end up getting sick breaking bread with Infected...

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Or at least, you're like me. Y'know, good things happen to good people and all. So that makes it perfectly fine to live with the Infected.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: She didn't know the danger she was putting herself in when she decided to keep Warmy around.

options: Amiya.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm here, Doctor.

options: Do you feel guilty about it?
Do you think fate smiled on us?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh, is it written all over my face or something? I was just thinking...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...I keep thinking, what would have happened... had you never pulled me from the wreckage of that vehicle?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Walking along the streets of Rim Billiton, I always feel like those running and shouting Cautus children... are no different from me.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Disasters aren't uncommon in Rim Billiton. The dangerous old ways of mining, the unusually frequent Catastrophes...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Heh. There were some Victorian businessmen who said this is no way for people to live.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh, of course I'm not trying to say that life in Rim Billiton is terrible or anything... Though the natural environment here may be harsh, our homes are always full of warmth.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rim Billiton's large households often come together to jointly adopt children.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But... I'm just happier that I get to do something like this.

options: Like being able to help Potlid?
Like fighting to protect the Infected?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Also, like being able to rescue you. And before that...
The young Cautus doesn't finish her words. You know there's something she's hiding from you.
Amiya's expression is somewhat wistful, but there's no sign of regret or remorse.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Now that I'm looking back, every year since I left home has been so terribly long.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Everything seems to be speeding by around me, before I can grow taller or change out of my childhood clothes.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: So, I find myself wondering... When I think of my mum and dad, what should I say to them to give them an idea of what I've been through...? So that they still recognize me?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But, coming back to Rim Billiton, it finally dawned on me.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The only thing I want to tell my parents is – I survived.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Because the Doctor took my hand.
You suddenly remember something.
You remember the huge Rim Billiton logo emblazoned on the laser mining module mounted atop the Rhodes Island landship. You remember seeing it before.
You remember some of the materials that Rhodes Island has gradually been making available to you lately.
Rhodes Island's predecessor, 'Babel,' customized this Rim Billiton mining module that was attacked during the initial shipment.
The mercenary team dispatched by Babel failed to stave off the attack, resulting in the deaths of many people on the transport team.
You remember the thick, black smoke, slowly burning in the empty wilderness.
Vague, distant emotions float into your mind along with the hazy memories.
Though it still doesn't feel like your own past, you cannot help but to feel an infinite...

options: ...Loneliness.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What I wanted to search for... Was the vestiges of the journey that began here.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: As well as the traces of Rhodes Island being dug out from here and towed across the entirety of Rim Billiton, before setting sail for the far reaches of the continent.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I was just thinking...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If I had never met Rhodes Island, if I had never met Dr. Kal'tsit or Theresa... If I had never met the Doctor––

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What a shame it all would've been.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Phew... Finally helped tidy up around here.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: But seriously, never would've expected Alanna and Warmy to be living together inside a truck like this. Good thing I didn't charge in, waving my hammer around, to try to rescue Warmy, or else this thing would've been a goner.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Speaking of which, when was the last time I had a campfire dinner with this many people?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Has there ever been another time where I got to enjoy such a merry one with Amiya and the Doctor?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: A grunt? That's it?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Does it not make your blood boil? Those bastards in suits want to plunder our mines! And since when did my friends become as snobbish as the Victorians?!

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: ...Sorry.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: I was just... thinking about the stories in some old books.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Don't look at us like that.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: The way you look at the stars in the sky.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: ...Even back then, I wasn't always happy every time.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Amiya and the Doctor... they're fast asleep?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Must've had too much fun and gotten tired, huh? Seriously, it's not safe here. You'll catch a cold at this rate...

options: Savage?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Huh?!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Doctor, you're awake?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: It's pretty dark tonight, and I couldn't see your face clearly and...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Did I wake you?

options: There are some beasts out there that never sleep.
Some people are still awake.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: So you're looking out for Amiya here, huh?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Fair enough. The Billy barrens have always been dangerous, and the people you meet aren't always friendly.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: ––Which is why, you have no idea how anxious I was when I first met you!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: You, a sickly foreigner, trekking through the wilderness with a little girl in tow! You were a goner!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: You weren't afraid because you didn't know a thing about Rim Billiton. I could write it off as Amiya trusting you regardless...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: ...But it wasn't until a lot later when I understood why she always slept so soundly next to you.

options: You make me sound smart.
You make me sound like I'm always on my toes.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Well, yeah. You have a good grasp of everything, and a lot of tools at your disposal.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: But, there are other areas where you don't seem that smart, which became evident the more we traveled together.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Like that one time you said, 'I know these berries are incredibly bitter,' but then took a big bite of them anyway before urging Amiya not to do the same.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: ...Well, yeah. You rarely get any time to rest.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Be it the barren wilderness, the glimmering of the starry sky, or the steel frames and cranes rising over a city, you can stare blankly at these things for a long, long time.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Maybe you didn't consciously decide to stay up to stand guard for Amiya, but you nevertheless managed to help her avoid some ferocious fowlbeasts and highwaymen.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Mind if I take a seat?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: ...It's just like it was.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: *sigh*... I wanted to tell you something along the way, but we ended up getting tangled up in another weird mess again.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: At least there wasn't any real danger.

options: Were our travels like this back then too?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Well... For me, the biggest difference was my attitude, I suppose?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: To be honest, I was a bit disappointed back then, and wanted to go for a walk. A really long one.

options: I heard about it from the other Rim Billitonian operators.
You would've been even more famous here.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Well, yeah. It was because of that 'Cage Incident.'

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: But after everything was said and done, I followed you and Amiya on that trip, and to everyone else, it seemed like I'd ghosted them. By the time I returned, they'd mostly forgotten about the whole deal.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Which is exactly what I wanted.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: At the time, I saw businessmen signing contracts to develop the mines for the people of Rim Billiton, but they turned around and threw us into cages, same way predators in the wilds snatch their meals.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: But, I'm even sadder about the ones who promised to protect our land together, swearing not to let the old dukes strip us of our dignity.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Some people, as soon as they tasted wealth and status, turned out no different from the businessmen and robber barons.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Hmph. Just thinking about it makes me want to swing my hammer around and smash their glass houses to bits.

options: Please calm down, Savage.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Oh! I'm so, so, so sorry, Doctor! I didn't mean to scare you...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Heehee. It feels crazy to be telling this story again.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: In any case, I was absolutely furious at the time.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: I couldn't stand that feeling. Like people were suddenly plucked out of their own skin, made to become completely different people. That look in their distant eyes... didn't seem like any way you'd ever look at a friend...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: To sum it all up, I can't trust them anymore.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: And so I... have trouble understanding certain others.

options: Might I, by any chance, know once such individual?
Whoever those 'certain others' are, I hope they can live up to your expectations.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: ...Yeah.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Don't worry about it. My hammer's just for protecting you.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: You and Amiya both gave me your answers.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Amiya already told me she's willing to go down that path, and doesn't regret it at all.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: I can see how heavily that burden sits on her shoulders, but now, all I can do is try to help her carry some of that burden.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: As for you, Doctor...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: This isn't right, Kal'tsit. What are you playing at here? What happened to Amiya's body? How could you leave a CHILD as young as her to suffer this?!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: ––Tell me, was this the Doctor's decision? Is she nothing but a pawn to the Doctor?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: I... I wanted you to swear to it. I couldn't shake the doubts that I had, but I also wanted to have faith in you, so I asked for a vow.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: You promised that after you took Amiya from Rim Billiton, that you'd do your best to treat her with kindness and let her grow up healthy... and free.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: ...Yeah, I know.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: There's no use asking for answers from an amnesiac Doctor.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: But how about you, Kal'tsit? Are you waiting too?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Alright, two can play at that game. Time will tell all.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: The same goes for you, Doctor.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: If there's anything you need from me, please let me know.

options: (Point into the distance)

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Hm? Already?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Oh, that's right.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: She's been sitting there all night.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Doctor, are you trying to say that she's a threat?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Or, is your assessment something altogether different?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: It's gotten late. Why don't you warm yourself by the fire?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: If anything, you should go rest and replenish your stamina, since you were the one who got hurt today.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Warmy made a ton of food, and Alanna already put it away in the truck. I can go grab it and heat some up for you if you'd like.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: She's quite the chef, you know. I'd feel bad for you if you missed out.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: How's she doing?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: She's fine now.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Actually, you should go see her yourself.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Thank you. All of you.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: But I... I felt her pain.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: I always thought I didn't fear pain... But now, I can't stop trembling.
The woman holding the weapon is not shaking at all.
She simply stares into the night sky, as if she dares not avert her eyes or look anywhere else.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: ...I've seen Infected burn themselves to ash.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Sometimes, the only choice for those Infected who can no longer be saved is to send them away.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Something like that... should never happen to Warmy.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: I... feel so terrible.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: From the very beginning... I was the reason why the truck went off-route.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Yeah. Alanna told me everything.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Do you want to turn around and leave?

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: But at least, I should...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Good enough for me. I mean, even the Doctor's interested in that Feranmut you mentioned now.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: The stars sure are beautiful, aren't they? You've been staring at 'em for a while now.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: ...I can't say.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: All I know is, they're far, far away, and shimmering in the darkness.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: It's slightly better than staring just at the darkness.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Are you afraid of the dark?

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: No. It's always so dark in the mines that I've long since gotten used to it.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: The mines, huh? Well, I guess you probably don't care too much then, huh?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: I totally get you. I used to work underground as a security officer, and it was always stuffy as hell.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: I also know that sometimes, people are too afraid to look at the things around them because they don't want to be sad, and so they look up into the sky.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: What about you?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: What do you see? And what are you looking for?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Why'd you decide to go truckjacking in the first place?
